_comment: Lines whose CER gate failed only because of the ASR/kana comparison, after reading the back-transcriptions (the speech is correct). pick() accepts takes of these ids up to CER 0.30. A scene line (#83) is accepted on one listened-for take only ({take, why}): make_scene_jobs.py pick uses that take, every other gate still applies.
